name: Parametric Octree Traversal
aliases: An efficient parametric algorithm for octree traversal
definition: A top-down ray-octree traversal algorithm that uses parametric coordinates to determine which child node to visit next, handling non-uniform octree depths.
summary: Parametric Octree Traversal is a top-down algorithm using parametric interval arithmetic to efficiently traverse non-uniform octrees by computing entry and exit times to skip empty subtrees without fixed depth or explicit stack management.
